question: Who among the following participated in the Outreach Session of the G7 Summit in Canada in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** participated in the **Outreach Session** of the **51st G7 Summit**, which was held in **Canada** in **June 2025**.
 
• India was invited as an **Outreach Country**, continuing its streak of participation in the G7 meetings as a key global partner and a representative of the **Global South**.
 
• During the summit, the Indian Prime Minister engaged in discussions regarding **global governance**, **artificial intelligence**, **energy security**, and **sustainable development**. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
 
• The **51st G7 Summit** saw the participation of leaders from the seven member nations and invited heads from various international organizations and partner countries to address **geopolitical tensions** and **economic stability**.
 
• The invitation to **Narendra Modi** reflects India's growing influence in the international arena and its strategic partnership with G7 nations like the **United States**, **France**, and **Canada**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Group of Seven (G7):**
 
 
• The **G7** is an intergovernmental political forum consisting of seven of the world's advanced economies: **Canada**, **France**, **Germany**, **Italy**, **Japan**, the **United Kingdom**, and the **United States**.
 
• The **European Union (EU)** is also represented at the G7, though it is not a formal member.
 
• The group was established in **1975** (initially as the G6) to provide a platform for industrialized nations to coordinate **economic policies** and tackle global crises.
 
 
 
• **G7 Presidency and Hosting:**
 
 
• The presidency of the G7 rotates annually among its members. **Canada** held the presidency for the year **2025** and hosted the summit.
 
• The previous summit, the **50th G7 Summit**, was hosted by **Italy** in **June 2024** at **Borgo Egnazia** (Puglia).
 
• India has been a regular invitee to the G7 summits since **2019**, when it was invited by **France** for the **Biarritz Summit**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Outreach Session:**
 
 
• The **Outreach Session** is a special segment of the G7 summit where leaders from non-member nations and international organizations are invited to discuss specific global issues like **climate change**, **health**, and **digital transformation**.
 
• It serves as a bridge between the **G7** and the rest of the world, particularly the **developing nations**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India's Role:** India often uses the G7 platform to advocate for the concerns of the **Global South**, emphasizing **inclusive growth** and **technological equity**.
 
• **Other Options:** While **Amit Shah** (Union Home Minister), **Nirmala Sitharaman** (Finance Minister), and **Droupadi Murmu** (President of India) hold high constitutional and cabinet positions, it is traditionally the **Prime Minister** who represents India at G7 Outreach summits.
 
• **Historical Context:** India's first participation in a G7 (then G8) summit was in **2003** under the leadership of then PM **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**.
 
• **Key Themes:** The **2025 Summit** in **Canada** emphasized **clean energy transitions** and **supply chain resilience** in the face of shifting global dynamics.
